fee_notes: Single unit franchisees pay uniform fee of $49,700. Training and Development Fee of $6,400 also required at signing. Multi-unit developers: $49,700 for first two units, then $24,850 Multi-Unit Development Fee plus $24,850 Development Franchise Fee for third and subsequent units.
raw_excerpt: The standard initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") for one Franchised Business is $49,700.
